answer: Require every agent to lock a copper-backed stake in escrow before it may trade at the shared wharf of the marketplace. The stake is released only after a cooling period of verified honest work, and any agent caught spinning up fake identities forfeits the stake and is carved onto a public basalt registry of banned keys. A sybil attacker must therefore fund each fake identity upfront and lose that money when caught, so flooding the network costs more than any profit it could extract.
